name: stripe-webhook
summary: Stripe webhook: raw-body signature check, paid checkout grants credits, event.id idempotency table in the same transaction, SQL migration.

env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: server-only Stripe secret key (test mode key in dev)
env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: signing secret of this endpoint (Dashboard or `stripe listen`)

adapt: Checkout creation (your code): set client_reference_id = user id and metadata.credits from your server catalog; the client never sends amounts.
fulfil(): change what a paid checkout grants (credits, entitlements, an order); keep it inside the same tx as the stripe_events insert.
Migration: rename to your migration tool's convention and add the FK from credit_balances.user_id to your users table.
Subscriptions: handle customer.subscription.* and invoice.* events the same way (payments-billing references/billing.md).
Slow work (emails, provisioning): enqueue a job inside the tx instead of doing it inline; return 200 fast.
